welcome.title: Welcome to the Investment Game
welcome.subtitle: This is a field experiment tool for a research study conducted by CIMMYT and CDA-BUK in Nigeria. It is a research game, used for research purposes only.
language.title: Select language
video.title: Watch this short video
video.subtitle: It explains how the game works. Watch it, then tap Continue.
enumerator.title: Session setup
instructions.title: How this game works
instructions.body: You will play 1 practice season and 10 real seasons. In each season you decide whether to use fertilizer on your maize, and if so, how much. Your harvest depends on the rainfall; your earnings depend on the rainfall and the market price. Both are uncertain, and you will be told the chances before each season.
instructions.tokenValue: The game is played with tokens, and each token is real money: 1 token = {rate} Naira. You start every season with {endowment} tokens (that is {endowmentValue} Naira). At the end of the game your tokens are paid to you in real Naira.

decision.confirm.body: You cannot change your decision after investing in fertilizer.

round.outlookBody: Read the outlook for rainfall and market price, then decide how much fertilizer to apply.
round.doseTitle: How much fertilizer will you apply?
round.doseBody: Each bag costs 1 token. You start the season with {budget} tokens; any you don't spend stay with you.
round.summaryDetail: Based on the realized maize harvest and market price, your fertilizer returned {ret} tokens (you invested {dose}).
round.summaryProfit: You earned {net} more than you invested.
round.summaryLoss: You did not recover your fertilizer cost this season.
round.summaryEven: You exactly recovered your fertilizer cost.
round.summaryNoFert: You did not buy any fertilizer this season — you kept all your tokens.
training.concept.title: Understanding chance with pictures
training.concept.body1: Think of 10 farming seasons. In some seasons the rain is good, in others it is normal, and in a few the rain fails and there is drought. We can show how often each kind of season happens using a picture like this:
training.concept.body2: Each small square is one season. In this picture, 7 of the 10 seasons have good rain, 2 have normal rain, and 1 has drought. When you see a picture like this in the game, it tells you what to expect for the next season.
training.count.title: Counting the seasons
training.count.body: Here are 10 more seasons. Before you tap the button, try to count in your head: how many have good rain, how many normal, how many drought?
training.count.answer: 5 good · 3 normal · 2 drought — out of 10 seasons.
training.check.title: Two quick questions
training.check.body: Answer both to make sure the pictures are clear. Wrong answers won't count — keep trying.
training.q.drought: Out of 10 seasons shown here, how many are likely to have drought?
training.q.priceMode: In these 10 seasons, which market price is more likely next time?
survey.q.usesFertilizer: Do you normally apply fertilizer to your maize?
